notices.text:
We want to inform you that, due to the orange weather alert issued by Arpal Liguria, the entire trail network will be closed all day tomorrow, Tuesday 20th October.

*********************************************************************************************************************************

For updates on trail conditions, we invite you to follow our WhatsApp channel (https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaBhb7TLNSZzuaz6pA3R) or our Telegram channel (https://t.me/FORliveinfo), where we post updates as soon as they become available.

*********************************************************************************************************************************

Thank you for your attention.
notices.title: TRAIL NETWORK CLOSURE – 20th OCTOBER 2026
